description: Submit a saved shortlist and renter brief to Taco Street with consent. Staff accepts the request before paid research starts; VAs verify gaps, then Alexander adds his judgment. Returns a private continuation link. No immediate report, guaranteed completion time, or tour booking. No email is sent by this tool.

agent.description: Self-reported referring assistant or product; not a verified partner identity.
agent.title: Agent

bedrooms.description: Bedroom count, 0 for a studio, 1–4 otherwise.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms

budget_basis.description: base_rent, total_monthly, or unknown when the renter has not specified.
budget_basis.title: Budget Basis

budget_flexibility.description: Defaults to target. Use hard_max only for an explicitly strict ceiling.
budget_flexibility.title: Budget Flexibility

budget_max.description: Monthly USD budget; specify its basis and flexibility separately.
budget_max.title: Budget Max

city.description: Supported search market for this shortlist.
city.title: City

consent.description: True only after the renter agrees to share this brief and contact for research and follow-up.
consent.title: Consent

contact.description: Renter's email or phone shared with consent for research follow-up.
contact.title: Contact

lease_term_months.description: Requested lease length if known; omit when unknown.
lease_term_months.title: Lease Term Months

move_in.description: Move-in month YYYY-MM or exact date YYYY-MM-DD. Never invent a day; confirm the year.
move_in.title: Move In

move_in_flexibility.description: Whether the move-in date is fixed or flexible.
move_in_flexibility.title: Move In Flexibility

notes.description: Renter requirements and questions, not assistant-generated promises.
notes.title: Notes

request_key.description: Generate a fresh cryptographically random URL-safe key (at least 32 random bytes, 43 encoded characters). Keep it private. Reuse it only to retry this identical request and retrieve its status; a different brief needs a new key.
request_key.title: Request Key

shortlist_token.description: The s parameter from the create_shortlist URL.
shortlist_token.title: Shortlist Token

name: request_apartment_research
title: Request an apartment research report
